column1: # Old HDFS bugs that make an ad hoc check itself fail (owner 2026-10-26: only a bug whose witness fires the point's own
# declared throw counts; /users/ZhenyuLi/oldbug on node1, "fires this point's own throw"). Each runs the ad hoc check of
# its point on a tree of its own, graphchecker/hdfs-checks with that bug put back by hand and a workload for it
# (experiments/hadoop/trees.tsv, hadoop-hdfs-bug-<jira>). The case directory hdfs-buggy-<jira> declares the check; its
# README the bug, the point, what was put back and why, and the result. A case's row is added with its directory.
